label: Сесть
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for сесть (to sit down).

missions.phrase: Я сяду у окна в поезде.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person perfective future. 'Сяду' is the 1sg future of perfective сесть, built on the irregular present stem сяд-, which looks nothing like the infinitive сесть. 'У окна' uses у + genitive 'by the window'.
Strategic focus: Second-person future. 'Сядешь' is the 2sg future of сесть on the сяд- stem. The imperfective partner садиться describes the act of sitting down repeatedly or in progress.
Strategic focus: Third-person future. 'Сядет' is the 3sg future of сесть. 'На место' uses на + accusative for the spot taken. The сяд- stem carries the future meaning of a single sitting.
Strategic focus: First-person plural future. 'Сядем' is the 1pl future of сесть on the сяд- stem. 'За столик' uses за + accusative for taking a seat at the small table.
Strategic focus: Polite/plural future. 'Сядете' is the 2pl future of сесть, still on the сяд- stem. 'В ряд' uses в + accusative for the chosen row.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural future. 'Сядут' is the 3pl future, completing the future scaffold of сесть. Note the present-future stem сяд- across all six persons.

missions.phrase: Он сел на диван и вздохнул.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past. 'Сел' is the masculine past of сесть, formed on the past stem сел-, distinct from the future stem сяд-. It reports a single completed sitting.

missions.phrase: Она села в кресло у камина.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine past. 'Села' uses the сел- past stem, marking a female subject. Past tense agrees in gender, not person, so the ending shifts with the subject.
Strategic focus: Plural past. 'Сели' is the plural past of сесть on the сел- stem, sharing nothing with the future сяд-. This closes the past series of the verb.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Сядь' is the irregular informal command from сесть, ending in a soft sign with no vowel. The imperfective partner садиться would frame the act as ongoing.
